bases.name: IJob
bases.marionette: A system of the game's own Rust module (decision 0062; HOWTO.md "Add a game's own Rust module"): native-array fields become `Vec` fields of a resource, `Execute` becomes the system body. Per-entity number loops can instead be job TypeScript steps (decision 0070).
bases.note: See PORTING.md "Burst jobs". `port_scaffold` writes a Rust skeleton (`jobs.rs`) for every job and the structs its fields use.

hooks.name: Awake
hooks.note: Marionette has one start hook, called on the first tick the entity runs. Put Awake code first, then Start code.

hooks.name: OnEnable
hooks.note: No enable/disable; runs once with start.

hooks.name: Update
hooks.note: Marionette only has fixed ticks (default 60 per second). Update and FixedUpdate both become update; Time.deltaTime is engine.dt.

hooks.name: FixedUpdate
hooks.note: Put FixedUpdate code before Update code in update (Unity's order within a frame).

hooks.name: LateUpdate
hooks.note: No hook after physics. Put the code at the end of update; cameras usually work better with the LookAt or Follow component.

hooks.name: OnCollisionEnter
hooks.note: Receives the other Entity, not a Collision. Contact points and impulse are not available.

hooks.name: OnCollisionEnter2D
hooks.note: Same hook in 2D.

hooks.name: OnTriggerEnter
hooks.note: Fires for contacts where either collider is a sensor (Collider.sensor: true).

hooks.name: OnTriggerEnter2D
hooks.note: Collider.sensor: true.

hooks.name: OnTriggerExit
hooks.note: Collider.sensor: true.

hooks.name: OnTriggerExit2D
hooks.note: Collider.sensor: true.

hooks.name: OnCollisionStay
hooks.note: Set a flag in self.state on enter, clear it on exit, act on it in update.

hooks.name: OnCollisionStay2D
hooks.note: Flag in self.state between enter and exit.

hooks.name: OnTriggerStay
hooks.note: Flag in self.state between enter and exit.

hooks.name: OnTriggerStay2D
hooks.note: Flag in self.state between enter and exit.

hooks.name: OnDestroy
hooks.note: Runs when engine.destroy removes the entity (end of the script stage), not when the run ends.

hooks.name: OnDisable
hooks.note: No enable/disable.

hooks.name: OnGUI
hooks.note: Immediate-mode GUI becomes UI entities; update their UiText from the script.

hooks.name: OnDrawGizmos
hooks.note: Editor-only drawing; drop it.

hooks.name: OnValidate
hooks.note: Editor-only; scene validation is `marionette op scene_validate`.

hooks.name: Reset
hooks.note: Editor-only; drop it.

hooks.name: OnMouseDown
hooks.marionette: UiButton (screen UI) or engine.justPressed + observe raycast

components.name: Transform
components.note: translation / rotation (quaternion x,y,z,w) / scale. No parent-child hierarchy: world space only.

components.name: RectTransform
components.note: anchor + offset (pixels, +y down) + size.

components.name: Rigidbody
components.note: kind Dynamic (isKinematic=false) or Kinematic; drag -> linear_damping, angularDrag -> angular_damping, freezeRotation -> lock_rotations, useGravity=false -> gravity_scale 0. Needs a Collider.

components.name: Rigidbody2D
components.note: 2D is chosen per scene; same component.

components.name: BoxCollider
components.note: half_extents = size / 2. isTrigger -> sensor: true. PhysicMaterial -> friction / restitution.

components.name: BoxCollider2D
components.note: half_extents = size / 2 (z ignored).

components.name: CapsuleCollider
components.note: half_height = height / 2 - radius (Unity height includes the caps).

components.name: MeshCollider
components.marionette: Collider { shape: TriMesh } (or ConvexHull when convex)

components.name: CharacterController
components.note: Driven by input actions (move_x, move_forward, jump) instead of Move(); a fully script-driven Move() is a gap.

components.name: Camera
components.note: fieldOfView -> Perspective.fov_y_degrees; orthographicSize * 2 -> Orthographic.height; backgroundColor -> clear_color.

components.name: Light
components.note: Directional lights only; point and spot lights are a gap.

components.name: MeshRenderer
components.note: Model.asset is a glTF file (import FBX models through library_import first).

components.name: SkinnedMeshRenderer
components.note: Skinning and skeletal animation are not supported yet.

components.name: SpriteRenderer
components.note: sortingOrder -> layer; color -> color.

components.name: AudioSource
components.note: playOnAwake -> trigger OnStart; loop -> looping. Play() from code: use trigger OnAction or OnCollision, or engine.emit; arbitrary Play() is a gap.

components.name: Text
components.note: Built-in bitmap font only, upper case.

components.name: TextMeshProUGUI
components.note: Built-in bitmap font only, upper case.

components.name: Image
components.marionette: UiNode + UiImage (or UiRect for a plain color)

components.name: Button
components.note: A click sets an input action for one tick; read it with engine.justPressed(action) instead of onClick listeners.

components.name: Canvas
components.note: Not needed: UiNode entities are always screen space.

components.name: Animator
components.note: No animation system yet.

components.name: NavMeshAgent
components.note: No navigation mesh; move with Follow or script steering.

components.name: Terrain
components.note: Use a glTF model with a TriMesh collider.
